newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: PAKISTANI RUPEE ENDS STEADY IN KERB IN DULL TRADE.
newsitem.headline: PAKISTANI RUPEE ENDS STEADY IN KERB IN DULL TRADE.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended steady at 41.30 to the dollar in the kerb market on Saturday on a depressed demand for the dollar and will remain pegged at these levels in the near term, dealers said.
"There was little demand for the dollar today as a liquidity crunch continued," one dealer said. "Speculators are trying their luck in stocks which are robust for the last one and half month or so."
The State Bank of Pakistan rate was unchanged at 40.5200/40.7226 to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer was unchanged at 2.0 percent. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
